speaker: Lezard
original_jp: ―― <PART> というのがディパンに残る最後の記〓でした
original_en:
At least, according to the last
remaining records of Dipan...

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …なんでこんなひなびた村に？
original_en: So, why this little backwater town?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 当時はおそらく もっと栄えていたのでしょう
original_en:
I imagine it was somewhat more
prosperous back then.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 〓〓は〓〓〓年以上 昔のものでした
original_en:
The chronicles date back over five
hundred years.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: よくそんな物が残ってたな
original_en:
Someone must have taken good care of
them.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …すみません私は知りませんでした
original_en:
I didn't know that.
Some princess I am...

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: ディパンは元々 オーブの守護者一族が分派して興した国だからさ
original_en:
Dipan was founded by a sect that broke
away from the tribe of Orb Guardians.

speaker: Dylan
original_en: Common knowledge for a loyal subject.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 過去は風化するものだ

original_en:
The orb was taken to a place just
outside Coriander for protection.
